items.description: A worker profile, including lifecycle, workplace, profile, and compensation fields.

address.description: The worker's home address, or null when unavailable.

city.description: The home address city or locality.

country.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the home address.

line1.description: The first line of the home street address.

line2.description: The second line of the home street address, or null when unused.

postalCode.description: The home address postal code, or null when unavailable.

state.description: The home address state, province, or region, or null when not applicable.

benefitEligible.description: The worker's stored benefits eligibility flag.

biologicalSex.description: The worker's biological sex, or null when unavailable.

compensation.description: The worker's current regular compensation, or the rate effective on a future start date. Null when the worker has no applicable regular pay rate or the API key lacks the corresponding compensation read scope.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency of the pay rate.

display.description: The server-formatted pay rate, including its period.

payRateId.description: The tag of the pay rate.

per.description: The period represented by the pay rate amount.

customFields.description: The worker's custom field values. Every active company custom field appears; fields outside this API key's permission scopes are redacted (value null, redacted true) rather than omitted, so the list is identical across keys. Empty when the company has no custom fields.

items.description: One returned record.

display.description: The value rendered as the Warp dashboard displays it; null when unset or redacted.

id.description: The tag of a company custom worker field.

redacted.description: True when this API key’s permission scopes cannot read the field’s category. The value fields are withheld (null), not absent — null does not imply the worker has no value.

value.description: The worker’s text; null when unset or when the field is redacted for this API key.

dateOfBirth.description: The worker's date of birth, or null when unavailable.

department.description: The department the worker belongs to, or null if unassigned.

id.description: The unique public id of the department

displayName.description: The "ui" name of a worker. If it's a business contractor business name is used. Otherwise we default to preferred name, then first-last.

email.description: An email with a reasonably valid regex (based on RFC 5321 atext characters)

endDate.description: The worker's final day of employment, or null when employment is ongoing.

latestRehireDate.description: The date the worker was most recently reactivated after an offboarding. This is distinct from startDate and is null if the worker has not been rehired.

level.description: The worker's assigned job level, or null if unassigned. Omitted when job levels are not enabled.

id.description: The unique public id of the job level

manager.description: The worker's manager, or null if unassigned.

maritalStatus.description: The worker's marital status, or null when unavailable.

phone.description: The worker's personal phone number, or null when unavailable.

primaryWorkplace.description: The primary workplace the worker is assigned to, or null if unassigned.

startDate.description: The worker's employment start date. Reactivation after an offboarding is reported separately in latestRehireDate.

tShirtSize.description: The worker's stored T-shirt size, or null when unset or unavailable.

terminationReason.description: The reason the worker was terminated, or null when no termination reason is recorded.

timeZone.description: The IANA timezone of the worker (e.g., America/New_York).

workEmail.description: An email with a reasonably valid regex (based on RFC 5321 atext characters)
